verdict.rationale: Maritime's billing docs describe the opposite of per-second usage pricing: a subscription with a fixed number of agents and flat-priced extras, with "No meters, no hourly rates: how much your agents run never changes the bill." Always-on is also sold as a flat add-on. The pricing axis applies to this hosting platform, but there is no per-second, usage-based compute billing.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
